cands.name: Darren Armstrong
cands.bio: Farmer and business owner from Hyde County, now living near Belhaven in Beaufort County. Co-owner of Armstrong Farms for nearly 30 years; family also runs a seed conditioning business. Past chair of the U.S. Grains Council. Beat incumbent Keith Kidwell in the 2026 Republican primary. No prior elected office found.

endorsements.text: N.C. Commissioner of Agriculture Steve Troxler, as stated on his campaign site.

cands.gaps: He has held no legislative or other voting office, so there is no voting or bill-sponsorship record. We found no stated positions from him on data centers, homestead property taxes, limits on investor or foreign land buying, growth and land conservation, immigration or H-1B, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. Ballotpedia says he did not complete its 2026 Candidate Connection survey and lists no endorsements for him. His birth year is only given as 1971 or 1972, and no exact birthplace beyond Hyde County was found. No controversies were found in the pages reviewed.

local.label: Roots 100: His campaign site says he was born and raised in Hyde County, and Wikipedia says he was raised there and lived there until 2020 before moving to neighboring Beaufort County.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: Co-owner of Armstrong Farms for nearly 30 years and operator of a seed conditioning business; past chair of the U.S. Grains Council and of the Corn Board Association of North Carolina; past president of the Hyde County Chamber of Commerce.
qual.why: He has long experience owning and managing a business, which fits the middle band. No prior legislative service, and no law or policy career, was found. Board and association roles are not counted.
